summary: Full backend + frontend regression for the 5 new Glint features (Golden Hours, Glint Spark, Voice Stories, Inner Circle, AI Caption Studio). Backend: 45/45 pytest passed (33 prior + 12 new in /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py). Frontend: mobile 375x667 web preview end-to-end verified via Playwright with fa@t.com/secret123 login. All new UI surfaces render correctly on the black/gold theme with no console errors: (1) Home shows Golden Hour banner testID='golden-hour-banner' with live countdown ('Starts in 22h 51m'); tap navigates to /golden which shows '#1 Golden Feed' with 'Golden Hour' badge and gold gradient card. (2) Post composer testID='home-create-post' opens with audience chips testIDs create-audience-public|friends|inner + create-ai-btn 'AI Caption Studio'; tapping AI opens overlay testID='ai-overlay' with tone chips ai-tone-witty/aesthetic/minimalist/bold/funny + ai-generate. 'Generate captions' with topic 'sunset over the mountains' returned exactly 4 non-empty witty suggestions inserted with + buttons. (3) PostCard shows spark button testID='post-spark-<id>' rendering coin icon + count and golden aura on golden posts. Sparking a friend's post succeeded (balance+/- as expected via API). (4) Profile → profile-settings opens Settings with testIDs settings-saved + settings-inner-circle; Inner Circle screen at /inner-circle shows '1/10' counter, member row with inner-remove-<username>, ADD FRIENDS section and 'gold star ring' explainer. (5) Saved posts route /saved renders empty state correctly. Voice stories tested at API level (create with media+duration, feed exposes media/duration/is_inner). Regression: /api/posts/feed audience filtering verified — inner-audience post visible to inner-circle friend but hidden from a non-inner friend; inner-audience story same behavior. Login and existing endpoints unchanged (all 33 legacy tests pass). Minor observation: one deprecation warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' logged by RN Web (non-blocking, from library, not app code).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' emitted twice during rendering. Not from app code — from a third-party RN component. No functional impact but should be traced if it appears on-screen elsewhere.

action_items: All 5 new features are working end-to-end on backend and frontend. Nothing blocking. Optional: (a) When Golden Hour is INACTIVE, /api/golden/status returns ends_at=null which is correct by contract, but the frontend banner shows 'Starts in 22h 51m · tap to see the glow' — verify copy also works during the active window (couldn't observe live since test ran outside 18:00-19:00 UTC). (b) Consider surfacing spark balance somewhere on Home (currently only inside profile-sparks) so users can see cost of tapping the spark coin. (c) Silence the RN-web pointerEvents deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Golden window logic in server.py:145 correctly computes active/next_start with UTC-aware datetimes. Posts pick up golden=active at create time — historical posts stay flagged after the window ends, which is desired for the 24h golden feed lookback.
Spark logic prevents self-spark and double-spark with clean 400 errors and atomically $inc's giver -1 / author +1 / post +1 with $addToSet on sparkers. Race-safe.
Inner Circle enforces friendship + max 10 correctly. Audience filter in can_view_post checks author.inner_circle for aud=='inner' which is correct (post author's circle, not viewer's).
AI captions endpoint uses emergentintegrations LlmChat with gpt-5.4-mini, returns 4 clean captions after stripping bullets/quotes. Empty/short lines filtered.
Voice stories: /api/stories accepts type='voice' with media+duration; feed emits both fields plus is_inner flag on the group. Good.
public_user() consistently excludes _id and password. No ObjectId leaks in any tested response.
server.py is 1641 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers/{auth,posts,stories,spark,inner_circle,admin}.py for maintainability (non-blocking).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested new-feature flows (golden banner+feed, composer audience chips, AI Caption Studio generate+insert, spark button, Inner Circle add/remove UI, Settings Saved+Inner Circle entries)
